description: BeachFinder helps you find and compare 184,900 swimming spots worldwide — beaches, lakes and bathing places. Search by city and rank spots for swimming, family, warm water, low wind, surf, snorkeling, whitewater or vanlife, then pull current weather, water temperature, wind, UV and wave planning signals for the top results. It also surfaces localized guides, source-backed activity providers and an anonymous aggregate of community reports. Every result links to getbeachfinder.com. All tools are read-only, and no tool ever declares a spot safe to swim — BeachFinder defers to official closures, flags, lifeguards and local authorities.
